points.description: States that the region of rejection is a range (set) of values of the test statistic (or sample result), e.g. 'range of values'. Equivalent wording such as 'set of values' or 'values of the test statistic' earns the mark.

States that these values are the ones that lead to rejection of the null hypothesis (H0), i.e. if the test statistic falls in this region, H0 is rejected. Equivalent wording such as 'values for which H0 is rejected' earns the mark.
